Connection settings could not be read or saved. Check available device storage, then try again. Your previous settings have been retained.
Choose a server to load your tasks. Your connection will be saved on this device.
Use HTTPS for a physical device. The server must be running separately. Test Connection checks this address without saving it.
Android emulator only: http://10.0.2.2:5087/ reaches a backend running on your computer. It is not a physical-device address.

HTTP is unencrypted and the demo API has no authentication. Use disposable data on a trusted network. Standard builds permit HTTP only to the emulator host 10.0.2.2; other hosts require HTTPS. An explicitly configured debug build may permit one private LAN host.
